fees.notes: International (UKMi) tuition per UKMShape fee schedule 2024/2025: RM33,110 total (incl. first-semester registration) for 2 semesters; per_year = total / 1 years (derived). mapped to the Faculty of Islamic Studies Master (Mixed Mode) rate; the Nusantara-region coursework variant is priced separately. Source: https://shape.ukm.my/storage/lampiran/struktur_yuran/FPI/pasca/strukturyuran_FPI_UKMi_pasca_F_int.pdf (accessed 2026-09-18).
